problem.statement: Late dispatch rate increased from 5.1% to 12.4% during the current week.

checks.result: No definition change during the period.

signal_validation.notes: The anomaly persists after removing duplicate scans.

observations.statement: Three facilities account for 76% of additional late dispatches.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Carrier pickup delays drove the increase.
hypotheses.mechanism: Later carrier arrival shifts otherwise-ready orders beyond dispatch SLA.
evidence_for: Median pickup delay increased 41 minutes at the three affected facilities.
evidence_against: Two unaffected facilities use the same carrier but different pickup windows.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Order volume spike drove the increase.
hypotheses.mechanism: Higher volume exceeded facility processing capacity.
evidence_against: Comparable prior weeks handled larger volume without SLA deterioration.

leading_explanation.statement: Delayed carrier pickups at three facilities are the strongest supported driver of the observed SLA deterioration.

confidence.rationale: Temporal ordering and facility concentration support the explanation, but no controlled intervention has yet been observed.
would_reduce: Continued late dispatches despite restored pickup timing.

impact.summary: The deterioration affected outbound service performance in the West region.
measured: Late dispatch rate increased by 7.3 percentage points.

unknowns: Whether driver scheduling or dock congestion caused the carrier arrival delay.

containment: Temporarily move pickup windows earlier at the three affected facilities.
corrective: Reconcile carrier schedule adherence against contracted pickup windows.
preventive: Create an alert for pickup deviation above 20 minutes.
investigation: Analyze dock availability and carrier GPS arrival timestamps.

validation_plan.comparison_method: Compare affected facilities before and after pickup-window correction, with unaffected facilities as reference.
validation_plan.success_criteria: Late dispatch rate returns within two percentage points of the 5.1% baseline.
validation_plan.rollback_or_escalation: Escalate to facility processing analysis if rate remains above 8%.
